system.notes:
Haunted masks look like typical masks worn in theater or revelry, but they are vaguely unsettling when scrutinized. A malicious spirit has bound itself to the mask, and that energy warps and twists the mask’s visage in subtle ways. A mask with exaggerated features that radiate a strong emotion.

AC 18, HP 14, ATK 1 bite +3 (1d4), MV close (climb), S -2, D -3, C +1, I +1, W +1, Ch +3, AL C, LV 3

Possess. A humanoid who dons the haunted mask must make a DC 15 CHA check. On a failure, the mask possesses it until the wearer falls unconscious or the mask is destroyed.

Emotion. In addition to its Possess talent, each haunted mask has one of the below talents based on the emotion it depicts. Anger: The wearer attacks the nearest creature on each of its turns. The wearer gains 10 temporary HP and deals +1d4 damage. Fear: The wearer becomes jumpy and flees at the slightest sign of danger. The wearer’s shrill, uncontrollable screams attract a great deal of attention. Sorrow: Unbearable sadness overcomes the wearer and they turn their weapon upon themselves. Mirth: The wearer falls to the ground in a fit of hideous, gasping laughter. In addition to the noise, the wearer begins suffocating as if drowning.
